0x000932.en: 「With my skills as they are now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0009A3.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000A2B.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000AA5.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000C00.en: 「Nngh, so this is where it ends!」

0x000C55.en: 「Hnh! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000C90.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　Not funny...」

0x000CE4.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000E35.en: 「This is the end... I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EE1.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000F2E.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000F6C.en: 「Kyaah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x00105E.en: 「Kh...... So I'm to become a shooting star...... Ejecting!」

0x0010DD.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go......!」

0x001115.en: 「Owowow...... I give up. Guess I miscalculated.」

0x001207.en: 「Kh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00124E.en: 「I'm sorry. I leave the rest to you.」

0x001283.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x001340.en: 「Kh...... You're as good as they say.」

0x00136F.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still green...!」

0x0013BD.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x001478.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x0014A7.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001514.en: 「I can go no further. I'll take my leave.」

0x00159F.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x001705.en: 「Ejecting...@ Kh...! Guess I can't look cool either...」

0x0017C3.en: 「Kh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0019D5.en: 「No good, they went and got me.」

0x001A70.en: 「What? Don't you mean the South Pole?」

0x001AA7.en: 「No, sir. Ignis headed toward the airspace above the North Pole.@ It matches Earth's current position along its orbital path as well.」

0x001B3C.en: 「You're saying Ruina has a base at the North Pole too......」

0x001B82.en: 「Or perhaps an entrance to the dimensional rift@ exists in the skies above it.」

0x001BF0.en: 「But why the North Pole?@ It's the farthest point from Antarctica, Ruina's home base.」

0x001C64.en: 「Most likely there's something there tied to@ the creation or upkeep of the dimensional rift.」

0x001CDB.en: 「Hmm......@ There's also the matter of why Ignis left the Heaven's Gate@ and made for Earth.」

0x001D59.en: 「Either something happened that forced him to rush back,@ or else......」

0x001DBF.en: 「Captain, multiple explosion flashes detected in the airspace ahead!@ The Space Force fleet and Ruina are engaged in combat!」

0x001E3F.en: 「So the Space Force noticed Ruina's movements too.@ Then while the enemy's attention is drawn there,@ we'll cut deep into their ranks.」

0x001EF3.en: 「Tesla Drive, maximum output!@ Deploy Break Field! Over Boost!」

0x001F7D.en: 「Don't falter, crush the enemy vanguard!@ Show them the pride of the 3rd Orbital Patrol Squadron!」

0x001FF5.en: 「Hmph. No matter how many humans swarm,@ the Atrum Exterior cannot be breached!」

0x002069.en: (There's surely a reason they gathered here......@ To solve Earth's disappearance, I can't withdraw now!)

0x002127.en: 「High-speed object approaching!@ Nine o'clock, ten degrees below, coming straight in! Just one!」

0x0021A2.en: 「No, it's the Steel Dragon Squadron's Hagane!」

0x0021D3.en: 「The Hagane is charging into the center of the enemy formation!」

0x002210.en: 「Those fools, acting on their own again......!」

0x002244.en: 「Haha! @ So it stung, letting me slip away last time!?@ Either way, worthy prey is always welcome!」

0x0022F0.en: 「......Umbra,@ we've reached above the Septemplum.@ How goes it on your end?」

0x002458.en: 「Communication trouble......? Something wrong down there?@ Either way, unless Ventos opens the Septemplum,@ we can't enter the Atrum Exterior.」

0x002595.en: 「Hold this ship in position!@ Main cannons one through four, prepare to fire!@ Launch all units!」

0x002610.en: 「Heh heh heh, it's them.@ So they've come to strike at this very moment.」

0x002669.en: 「That machine's a new face. A Melior Esse, maybe?」

0x0026AF.en: 「That's no machine, that's a monster, a monster!」

0x0026EC.en: 「Heh heh heh heh, humans.@ I am Contagio, of the Melior Esse.」

0x00274B.en: 「Now, let the feast of terror and slaughter begin.@ To lead all things to ruin. Heh heh heh heh.」

0x0027F3.en: 「I mean, there was nothing like that among@ the Guests or the Inspectors either.」

0x002858.en: 「Good grief, they keep getting more over-the-top to look at.」

0x00289E.en: 「Monsters and freaks, this is straight-up tokusatsu now, tokusatsu!」

0x0028E7.en: 「It looks like Dogragio, from Superbeast Warrior Gigaseed......」

0x002962.en: 「A villain from an old tokusatsu show Ryu showed me once.」

0x0029C1.en: 「Ho, you don't flinch even at the sight of me and Violaceum.」

0x002A07.en: 「Sorry, but I got used to the sight of inhuman types@ before I came back to this world.」

0x002A69.en: 「Huh? @ Wait, are you into tokusatsu too!?」

0x002AC9.en: 「Heh heh heh, now I'm curious about your memories.」

0x002B0F.en: 「......Contagio, was it?@ The reason you're in this airspace......@ it's because there's an entrance to the dimensional rift, isn't it?」

0x002BC0.en: 「Heh heh, you humans@ cannot enter the Atrum Exterior.」

0x002C87.en: 「And what's this about humans not being able to enter......」

0x002CC1.en: 「So only Ruina can pass back and forth......?」

0x002D0A.en: 「Even so, we didn't come all this way@ just to turn back now!」

0x002D66.en: 「Yes...... By fighting them in this airspace,@ there may be something we can learn.」

0x002DE0.en: 「Elaive 1 to all units!@ To solve the mystery of the dimensional rift,@ we cannot afford to withdraw here!」

0x002E5E.en: 「Listen up, our backs are to the wall! @ Protect the Hagane while you take down the enemy!」

0x002EC0.en: 「Heh heh heh, I'll fill your souls with terror and despair,@ and offer them up to the King of Ruin!」

0x002F40.en: 「Multiple Ruina units approaching! Coming straight in from seven o'clock!」

0x002F89.en: 「Hahaha! @ This is what you get for diving in so carelessly!@ A pincer attack, humans!」

0x002FFE.en: 「Multiple enemy shots, high-speed approach! Lightning trails confirmed!!」

0x00307C.en: 「It's fire from the 3rd Orbital Patrol Squadron behind us!」

0x0030F6.en: 「Hmph, small fry!@ Struggle all you like, your fate won't change!」

0x003158.en: 「All units, relay this! @ Concentrate your attacks on the Melior Esse!」

0x0031AB.en: 「If a top brass like you looks like that,@ your boss must be one hell of a monster!」

0x003213.en: 「You'll never lay eyes on the King of Ruin.@ You'll die before then, heh heh heh.」

0x00328A.en: 「Nah, I'll get a look at his ugly mug too!@ And then I'll take him down!」

0x0032E0.en: 「I'm not letting you get away today, Ignis!」

0x003314.en: 「That's my line! Die together with your despair!」

0x003357.en: 「You lot seem to've rushed here in a hurry......@ Did something happen?」

0x0033BC.en: 「Even if you knew, your fate wouldn't change.@ Raise your cries of resentment and scatter into the void!」

0x00343C.en: 「Let's see just how you plan to get back to Earth!」

0x003492.en: 「Hmph, you'll never see Earth again.@ You die right here!」

0x0034F1.en: 「Answer me! Where's the entrance to Earth!?」

0x003531.en: 「Heh heh heh, even if you knew,@ your kind couldn't open the door!」

0x003596.en: 「There has to be an entrance to the dimensional rift!@ Where is it!?」

0x0035EC.en: 「Hmph, you think I'll just tell you?」

0x003629.en: 「I'll drag it out of you, by force if I have to!」

0x00365D.en: 「You're going to show us the way to Earth, Contagio.」

0x0036A0.en: 「Heh heh heh, no human can break through@ the Atrum Exterior.」

0x00370E.en: 「Then it's worth testing whether@　the same can be said of me.」

0x003773.en: 「Why did you come to the skies above@　the North Pole, and not the South?」

0x0037CC.en: 「Heh. You'll die before you get@　that answer!」

0x003837.en: 「Could it be you can't break through@　the dimensional rift on your own either?」

0x0038BE.en: 「If a door to Earth lies there,@　then I'll open it...!」

0x003911.en: 「Heh heh heh. Even if you open the door,@　only despair awaits you!」

0x00397F.en: 「Hahaha! Clinging to unseen hope, human?@　It's all in vain!」

0x0039DE.en: （Hope... will I find it where I'm bound...?）

0x003A2A.en: 「That guy's way more of an alien@　than the Aerogaters ever were!」

0x003A7D.en: 「Heh heh heh. You'll never understand@　why I take this form!」

0x003AFA.en: 「I'll dye that machine an even deeper@　crimson with my flames!」

0x003B3A.en: 「To learn how to return to Earth,@　I cannot back down here!」

0x003BA8.en: 「Heh. I smell a strong one. Your fear@　and despair will taste exquisite!」

0x003C1C.en: 「Hmph, you'll pay dearly. Your life@　won't even begin to cover it!」

0x003C62.en: 「...A gate far wider than any frontier@　we once sought, and a far shorter road.」

0x003D0A.en: 「That I don't despair so easily,@　that's what!」

0x003D56.en: 「Heh heh heh. This power...@　you humans are not to be taken lightly.」
